description: K₅Na₃Ta₇NbO₂₄ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are four inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with seven TaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.84 Å) and eight longer (2.85 Å) K-O bond lengths. In the second K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four KO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with seven TaO₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (2.84 Å) and four longer (2.85 Å) K-O bond lengths. In the third K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with seven TaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.84 Å) and eight longer (2.85 Å) K-O bond lengths. In the fourth K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with seven TaO₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (2.84 Å) and four longer (2.85 Å) K-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with seven TaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four KO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with seven TaO₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (2.83 Å) and four longer (2.84 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TaO₆ octahedra, faces with three NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with five KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are three shorter (2.00 Å) and three longer (2.01 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TaO₆ octahedra, faces with three NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with five KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are three shorter (2.00 Å) and three longer (2.01 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the third Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TaO₆ octahedra, faces with three NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with five KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are three shorter (2.00 Å) and three longer (2.01 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the fourth Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TaO₆ octahedra, faces with three NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with five KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the fifth Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TaO₆ octahedra, faces with three NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with five KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.01 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TaO₆ octahedra, faces with three NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with five KO₁₂ cuboctahedra.
